the Q deficiency observed is not due to a defect in the synthesis of the polyisoprene chain but rather due to a defect of the Q biosynthetic enzyme.

The main takeaway from our work is that
Q is a critical lipid antioxidant that is synthesized from the same precursor as cholesterol, and that a deficiency in the synthesis of this critical lipid antioxidant leads to kidney failure.
